title: Art Tatum, the Hawkins session and humble musicians
summary: Dance praises the Hawkins, Trummy and Earl session. Thomas defends Art Tatum's playing with other musicians, saying he and Duke were humble and wanted others comfortable.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
